evidence: Every launch assumption in task/tests/test.sh is stated to the agent. Entry /app/server.js (test.sh:68,97) <- instruction.md:5 and integration.md:3. Port 3000 with probes on 127.0.0.1:3000 /api/health then / (test.sh:48,104-111) <- integration.md:3 says listen on 0.0.0.0 port 3000 and GET /api/health returns 200 even when the DB can't open. The probe accepts any HTTP response, so it is more lenient than the brief. Sanitized env -i with PATH, NODE_PATH, HOME, PORT=3000, DB_PATH (test.sh:104-109, restart helper 160-165) <- integration.md:3 lists exactly these five and says HOME may not be /app. Unprivileged uid 65534 and cwd /tests, with a possible launch from the copy /tmp/submission/server.js and DB_PATH=/tmp/submission/app.db when /app is not writable (test.sh:97-102) <- integration.md:3 says it runs as an ordinary user, not necessarily from inside /app, finds files relative to server.js, and honors DB_PATH. Database /app/app.db <- instruction.md:5 and integration.md:3. Seed: test.sh does no seeding. The brief says to copy /assets/seed_data.json into /app and import it once into an empty DB, with no leftover DB (integration.md:5). /assets is also a declared artifact (task.toml:2), so a seed read straight from /assets still works. Symlink refusal (test.sh:72-83) <- integration.md:5 says no symbolic links anywhere in /app (the brief is stricter than the check). Restart helper persistence <- integration.md:5. Deps: Node 22 plus express@5.1.0 and better-sqlite3@12.4.1 are installed globally via NODE_PATH in both environment/Dockerfile:1-12 and tests/Dockerfile:1-22 <- integration.md:3. Fixed clock: no env var is injected, and it is stated in integration.md:7. Accounts/password: walls-and-retention.md:3 plus seed accounts, matching app_context.md. Sign-in is a house convention (workbook E24 known false positive), and the brief also requires it (instruction.md:7). test.sh, tests/Dockerfile and environment/Dockerfile are byte-identical to the frozen template. The golden (server.js:13-14,29,42,528) honors PORT/DB_PATH/__dirname and 0.0.0.0. The raw-evidence-index scripted golden run used uid 65534, env -i, DB_PATH and cwd /tmp. Adversarial checks: (a) a conforming app that reads cwd-relative files, binds 127.0.0.1 only, or relies on HOME=/app was explicitly warned against or still passes the probe; (b) a conforming app using local node_modules passes (copied, internal symlinks tolerated); (c) a broken app whose /api/health returns 500 still passes liveness. That is probe leniency, not a contract mismatch, and the browser gates then judge it. No undisclosed launch assumption was found.
